description: This file contains unit tests for the Secret class, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.config.raw package. The tests verify immutability, equality/hashcode contract, and proper handling of null parameters in instance creation, as well as correct retrieval of name and value fields.

classes.name: SecretTest
classes.description: A set of unit tests for the Secret class, including immutability, equality, null handling, and getter methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the Secret class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of Secret class follow the contract.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullName
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Secret with a null name throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Secret with a null value throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getName() returns the correct secret name.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getValue() returns the correct secret value.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toString() output contains the name and value substrings.
